title_audio_frequency(hz) after successful audio device initialization
mix_title_audio(pcm) after existing endian/channel conversion, before SDL_QueueAudio
behavior: Whole provided recording starts once at original first intro voice event65D74; original second voice event66488 is suppressed only when first replacement succeeded in this intro cycle. All other banks/instruments/sounds/callers remain original, including intro SFX8/13/11/14 and Claytality26. Equal-power center/saturating16bit addition preserves music/SFX and nativeSFXvolume; active duplicate events cannot stack/restart. Missing/invalid assets/metadata retain original calls.
capture: Optional CLAY_CAPTURE_AUDIO=private.wav writes mixed stereo PCM WAV without a playback device; diagnostic capture capped128MiB and fixed initial frequency.
native_rng: If original title pitch-random flag entry_sp+0x20 is nonzero, invoke ORIGINAL func_800C1520 once on local context. This preserves guest RNG progression without changing the supplied recording.
correction: 40728/sound26 is the Claytality combat effect and is NOT a title hook. Both correct intro calls observed in actual35sec empty-input boot trace.
